fit: Nonnegative weighted least squares of log(v23/v_lane) against x, zero intercept; weights=lane vehicle count.
assumptions: 110km/h is a fixed free-speed reference for this screen; VSL-limited free flow may be confounded and must not be claimed qualified.
comparison: Native whole-cell speed times the measured initial lane/whole ratio for each case.
gate: Combined vehicle-weighted holdout MAE at least10% lower than fixed initial ratio; no holdout arm MAE more than25% worse.
stage: Necessary observation-closure screen only. Current native aggregate inputs are substituted, not autonomous prediction. Future frames are used as labels only; trailing merge counts end at current time.
next_if_fail: Reject this formula without fitting more coefficients or launching rollouts.
